title: Awesome Tech Talks video record
description: Schema specification for video records in the Awesome Tech Talks dataset hosted on Hugging Face (tech_talks_unified.parquet).

company.description: Host organization or engineering team behind the session.

channel.description: Source YouTube channel name where the session was published.

video_type.description: Visibility status on YouTube (public or unlisted replay).

title.description: Full title of the talk or workshop.

upload_date.description: Publication date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), or unknown when not provided by the source.

shareable_url.description: Direct canonical link to the video session.

duration_seconds.description: Total duration of the session in seconds.

topics.description: Standardized taxonomy topic tags assigned to the session.

heading.description: Extracted section heading or topic transition title.

heading_confidence.description: Confidence level of heading extraction (high or low).

start_time.description: Timestamp offset where the segment begins (HH:MM:SS or MM:SS).

text.description: Cleaned, normalized transcript text for the segment.

segments.description: Array of segmented transcript chunks with timestamps and section headings.

full_transcript.description: Complete concatenated transcript text for the full session.
